base_queries.name: txn_summary
base_queries.nrql: SELECT count(*) AS 'n', average(duration)*1000 AS 'avg_ms' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

base_queries.name: throughput
base_queries.nrql: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'req_per_min' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

deep_dive_queries.name: latency_by_txn_p95
deep_dive_queries.nrql: SELECT percentile(duration, 95)*1000 AS 'p95_ms' FROM Transaction {{appNameClause}} FACET name LIMIT 20 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago

deep_dive_queries.name: errors_by_txn
deep_dive_queries.nrql: FROM TransactionError SELECT count(*) AS 'count' {{appNameClause}} FACET transactionName LIMIT 20 SINCE {{window}} minutes ago
